## Description

Learns a compressed nonlinear representation of cross-sectional returns or features, then trades residual mispricing relative to the latent representation.

## Where it may fit

Large correlated universes with nonlinear common factors, if residuals remain stable out of sample.

## Vehicles

Equity market-neutral, statistical-arbitrage, and cross-asset quant portfolios.

## Required data

Synchronized returns/features across a point-in-time universe, corporate actions, training windows, risk factors and trading costs.

## Caveats

Latent residuals may reflect model error rather than mispricing; regularization, walk-forward refits and factor-exposure diagnostics are essential.
